components.name: Flag
components.description:
Figma Flag (7063:63834, 🍑 Iconography): 260 round country and region flags, 24×24 in Figma. A flag identifies a
country next to its name (locale pickers, phone codes, addresses, holiday calendars); it is never the only label.
Until the flag data has loaded, the same circle shows in Neutral/Subtle.

props.name: name
props.description: Figma Flag `Name`: the country or region, spelled as in Figma (e.g. "Vietnam", "United Kingdom").

props.name: size
props.description: Figma Size: Small 16 · Medium 24 (default) · Large 32, on the Image-Size scale (Avatar XSmall = Medium).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for a flag that stands alone. Omit it when the country name sits next to the flag (decorative).
